tools.name: camps_near
tools.description: Camp records within a straight-line radius (up to 50 miles) of a latitude and longitude, nearest first. National parks are not in the records.

tools.name: free_camping_near_town
tools.description: Up to 5 free camps within 25 straight-line miles of a US town, nearest first, each with cost evidence, water, nearest toilet, the season reading for today, its record URL, and what is unrecorded. Also gives the site's page for that town when one exists.

tools.description: The hand-checked AI runs of the camping game Dispersed 3D for a challenge (default the newest), best run per model, with habits kept, gas and water left, a link to watch each run, and the count of runs.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "trip_status" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: find_camps, forest_weather, changes_since · Private data: find_camps, camp_detail, camps_near, free_camping_near_town, plan_four_nights, rig_math, forest_weather, changes_since, what_we_cover, trip_check, land_at · Public sink: forest_weather, trip_check · Destructive: plan_four_nights, game_leaderboard, one_call, what_we_cover, trip_check.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: find_camps, forest_weather, changes_since · Private data: find_camps, camp_detail, camps_near, free_camping_near_town, plan_four_nights, rig_math, forest_weather, changes_since, what_we_cover, trip_check, land_at · Public sink: forest_weather, trip_check · Destructive: plan_four_nights, game_leaderboard, one_call, what_we_cover, trip_check

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
